text: William James's 'specious present' (1890) is best described as:
choices: The voluntary recollection of a recently past event
A brief experienced duration — a 'saddle-back' — given as a single present
The objective time studied by physics and history
explanation: James's specious present is a brief experienced duration (a 'saddle-back' of a few seconds) that spans the just-past and just-arriving yet is given as one unified 'now.' It is perceptual rather than voluntary recollection, and it is explicitly distinguished from the instantaneous objective/physical present.
